observations.note: The self-check preview was killed at its time limit with no output and had to be run a second time, costing roughly 49 minutes of idle waiting.
The session polled for the preview's output with sleep loops in the shell instead of a declared command, and a stopped watcher was later mistaken for the preview itself.
Both fixes were already in HEAD, but it took many reads and greps of child.py and filing.py to establish that, with several files read twice.

conformance.item: Open the rule files with the read tool
Write the test first and see it fail for the right reason
Run only the test files the phase rows name, as plain commands
Run the preview once after the last change and change no file afterwards
Use only plain single declared shell commands
Write the code report and set the plan status to completed
